author.name: ハカセ アイ(Ai-Hakase)🐾生成AI・ComfyUI

summary_md: **ハカセ アイ(Ai-Hakase)🐾生成AI・ComfyUI ([@ai_hakase_](https://x.com/ai_hakase_/status/2116033108491288675))** covers **OpenBonsai**, an open PTQ framework reproducing Prism ML's PTQ1_0 ternary GGUF pipeline that compresses BF16 Qwen3.5-9B (~18 GB) to ~2 GB using signed Hadamard rotation, sequential GPTQ, FP16 group scales per 128 weights and scale distillation calibrated on the model's own reasoning traces; compressing takes ~5 hours on a 32GB GPU and inference needs Prism's llama.cpp fork ([esokullu/openbonsai](https://github.com/esokullu/openbonsai), [model](https://huggingface.co/webbrain-one/openbonsai-qwen-3.5-9b), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01078), [Reddit](https://reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/comments/1xie29o/i_opensourced_openbonsai_compress_your_own_bf16)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - esokullu/openbonsai: Independent experimental ScaleQ-style compression for Qwen3.5, with tests and original paper
